consequence.statement: A new optional flag is available; nothing changes for operators who do not use it.

original.statement: A new `--force-apply` CLI flag was added to override the idempotency logic when detection incorrectly assumes rules are already applied.

decision.reason: [ev-2f7235dbd19d] describes only the addition of an optional `--force-apply` flag that overrides the idempotency logic when an operator chooses to use it. Nothing in the evidence says that existing behaviour fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migration if the flag isn't used. A "none" consequence with an informational class is therefore supported. The note doesn't say whether the idempotency detection itself is new in this release, so no review-class consequence can be derived from it.
